profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer @ BAE Systems, Inc.
profile.summary:
Graduated with a Bachelor of Science in Computer Science from the University of New Hampshire. Earned a CompTIA Security+ certification in February 2023, highlighting a commitment to cybersecurity expertise.  

Currently a Software Engineer at BAE Systems, Inc., contributing to the development of features, fixes, and builds in collaborative sprints. Proficient in Java, HTML, and programming, with a strong focus on problem-solving and teamwork. Dedicated to achieving project goals alongside technical leads and team members, while leveraging technical skills to deliver results.
